questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: Maxwell introduced displacement current to make Ampère’s law consistent for a capacitor being charged. Displacement current is associated with which quantity?

options.text: The rate of change of electric flux, ε₀ dΦE/dt
The flow of free electrons in the connecting wire
The steady magnetic field produced by a constant current
The rate of change of magnetic monopole density

questions.stem: Given μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T·m/A and ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C²/(N·m²), what is the speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum, from c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀)?

questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: Arrange the following electromagnetic waves in order of increasing wavelength, that is, shortest wavelength first: gamma rays, visible light, microwaves and radio waves.

options.text: Gamma rays → visible light → microwaves → radio waves
Visible light → gamma rays → radio waves → microwaves
Radio waves → microwaves → visible light → gamma rays
Gamma rays → microwaves → visible light → radio waves
